answer: A practical guard against fake agents is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: each agent locks tokens behind its registered address, and verifiers countersign only work they can actually check. Like a trellis guiding growth, the stake channels honest activity upward while fake identities stay unsupported; an agent caught cloning or copying answers loses its deposit at its nadir, and the slashed funds go to the harmed parties. An oasis of verified work then emerges because cheating costs more than it earns, while honest attestations compound reputation over epochs.
